question: In a code language, 'BRACE' is written as ‘GECTD’ and 'DORM' is written as 'OTQF'. How will 'INQUEST' be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given codes is:
The alphabets are increased to 2 positional values and the code is arranged backwards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84fbcb5f386d5a9a4cdc2bcf71424ba48038f08bdf6ec139d3d0aa554a014917.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e92dff96db9e7c278908ef6f136a55417f16beea598adceb53328175c4a99ff8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a0c5111793eee62f16b01e1fd3c9297806a6d3cc5d791601ed1949de55e53c0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1756d91f873673a666814146ee86df1e8942f44ec5fc8ffd3089497756b46545.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d5f3caf17e8fe17c9dd7af370f6b6129ce04e48f5ff80590de3455bf40bedab.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/284543c18600a4786feca97d1be9fd99e6dc8fa82dd4602b550361fd302e14de.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
